entities.name: MSI2
observations: High MSI2 expression measured by real-time PCR was independently associated with inferior OS, EFS, and RFS in adult BCR-ABL-negative B-ALL; reported P values were 0.004, 0.001, and 0.018, respectively.

High MSI2 expression was associated with lower complete remission incidence, inferior OS, and shorter DFS in an independent adult BCR-ABL1-negative B-ALL cohort; reported P values were 0.03, 0.018, and 0.001, respectively.

entities.name: Adult B-ALL
observations: In two adult B-ALL cohorts, high MSI2 consistently predicted unfavorable remission and survival outcomes, particularly in BCR-ABL1-negative disease.
Evidence is specific to adult B-lineage ALL; pediatric ALL, T-ALL, AML, and mixed leukemia findings were not treated as direct evidence.

entities.name: PMID:23759245
observations: Study of 116 adults with B-ALL; MSI2 was measured by real-time PCR. High MSI2 was associated with inferior OS, EFS, and RFS and remained an independent adverse prognostic factor in BCR-ABL-negative disease.

entities.name: PMID:25090928
observations: Study of 140 adults with B-ALL; MSI2 was measured by real-time PCR. High MSI2 was associated with lower CR, inferior OS, and shorter DFS and was independently prognostic in BCR-ABL1-negative disease.

entities.name: PMID:36530989
observations: Systematic review and meta-analysis across cancers found high MSI2 associated with worse OS and DFS, but it was not an adult B-ALL-specific pooled analysis.
